turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, am I speaking with Mr. Gupta?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is Gupta speaking. Who is this?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I am Anjali from the City Clinic in Jaipur. I am calling to confirm your cardiology report is ready for pickup.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, the heart test. Is everything alright with the results?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The doctor has reviewed them and wants to discuss them with you in person. Do you have time for an appointment tomorrow at 11 AM?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Tomorrow? I think I can come, but will it take long?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It should be a quick fifteen minute consultation. Please just bring your previous file along with you.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I see. And about the billing, how much was the total for the tests?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: The total bill is one lakh rupees, including the specialized scan.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: One lakh! That is quite high. Do I need to pay it now over the phone?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, no, not at all. You can settle everything at the reception desk when you visit tomorrow.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Okay, that is a relief. I will see you tomorrow at 11 then.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Perfect. We will see you then, Mr. Gupta. Have a good day.
